## Objective and scope

Problem, expected behavior, out of scope, gate/work ID, dependencies.

## Contract and risk

Owning specification, affected invariants/capabilities, risk tier and reason, compatibility/resource/security/diagnostic impact (or not applicable).

## Acceptance evidence

Exact positive and negative cases, lowest effective test layer, required pre-merge checks, any separate qualification/promotion issue.

## Coordination

Owner, related work/affected modules, blockers or human decision needed. Link the PR and actual evidence at completion.
